name: cn.qingshi.gamesdk.core.impl.login.v3.V3LoginActivity
description: The Qingshi (YYXXGame) game SDK opens this Activity for player sign-in or account switching; it presents the sign-in and registration screens and returns the login result.
disableEffect: The affected Qingshi sign-in flow cannot open, so players cannot finish login or account switching through it.
